info.description: D-06: Category is a separate collection type from Tag, not one type with a discriminator. D-09: name + uid slug (targetField: name) + optional description. D-10: draftAndPublish is off — an assigned category must never be silently invisible on the live site. D-08: flat, no parent/child self-relation. The `articles` inverse relation (oneToMany, mappedBy: category) was added in Plan 06 alongside api::article.article.
